risk_if_not_implemented: Without Dynamic Management, unauthorized individuals, devices or services may gain access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services, Data and/or Facilities (TAASDF). Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Accountability / Attribution (R-AC-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Identification & Authentication for Organizational Users
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to uniquely identify and centrally Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA) organizational users and processes acting on behalf of organizational users.
compensating_control_1.justification: Identification & Authentication for Organizational Users (IAC-32) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Dynamic Management (IAC-13.4) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Standardized Identifier Management (User Names)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to govern naming standards for usernames and Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_2.justification: Standardized Identifier Management (User Names) (IAC-13.1) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Dynamic Management (IAC-13.4) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
